summary: This informational RFC describes how responsibilities for the RFC Series are divided among the RFC Series Editor, the RFC Production Center and the RFC Publisher. It also covers IAB oversight through the RFC Series Oversight Committee. It was replaced by RFC 8728.

eli5.summary: A book series needs someone who sets the rules, someone who makes the books, and someone who hands them out. This says who does which job.
